newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Millennium 1996 net loss HK$59.19 mln.
newsitem.headline: Millennium 1996 net loss HK$59.19 mln.

text.p: NOTE - Millennium Group, formerly known as Allied Industries International Ltd, is a property, building materials and manufacturing company.

The company proposed a bonus issue of one 1999 warrant for every 10 shares held. Each warrant will entitle the holder to subscribe in cash for new share of HK$1.00 each at an initial subscription price of HK$3.25 per share, subject to adjustement, at any time from the date of issue until June 30, 1999.

Net is after an exceptional loss of HK$31.25 million on provision for diminution in value of short-term investments, loss of HK$32.89 million on provision for doubtful debts, loss of HK$27.36 million on disposal of subsidiaries, gain of HK$18.77 million on write back of provision for liquidation cost for a subsidiary under liquidation and gain of HK$2.85 million on deemed disposal of an associated company.
The loss on disposal of subsidiaries of HK$27.36 million was calculated after deducting purchased goodwill of HK$44.01 million which was previously eliminated against reserves.
Total dividend for year is nil vs nil.
